note: Town list of this section for the town pages /si/<word>/ (scripts/loc_towns.py; SI1 09.11.2026, same rules as K5). A station belongs to the nearest town of this list within 25 km; a town has a page with at least 3 public stations or when `page` is true (pinned: a town that has a page keeps it — unpin only with a redirect). Reference: towns from 5,000 inhabitants plus resorts and transit towns from 1,000 (GeoNames ids where content/world/names/cities.csv has them; other rows have gid null and approximate coordinates and population — to be checked against GeoNames, CC BY 4.0), only towns that had a station in stanice.json of 03.11.2026. Fields: name (local official), slug, gid (GeoNames id), lat/lon, pop, loc (locative with preposition), region (statistical region), aliases, page, note.
